2. PROPRIETARY PRODUCT: DONNA AI
================================================================================

Product Name: Donna AI
Product Type: Autonomous Telephony AI Voice Agent
Developer / Provider: Relient Solutions
Canonical URL: https://relient.solutions/products/donna-ai
Alias URL: https://relient.solutions/donna

What Donna AI Is:
Donna AI is an enterprise-grade autonomous telephone voice agent designed to handle inbound and outbound business phone calls 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Unlike rigid IVR phone trees ("Press 1 for sales..."), Donna AI speaks in natural, human conversational cadence, understands interruptions, answers complex FAQs, qualifies leads, schedules appointments, and triggers backend business workflows in real time.

Technical Architecture:
- Sub-250ms voice latency via WebSockets and real-time audio streaming.
- Built on Fastify, Python, Twilio / SIP trunking, Whisper transcription, and low-latency speech synthesis.
- Direct tool-calling integration with Google Calendar, Cal.com, HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, and custom REST APIs.
- Enterprise data encryption in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256).

Key Donna AI Capabilities:
1. 24/7 Immediate Inbound Call Answering: Zero hold times and no missed calls during peak hours or after-hours.
2. Intelligent Lead Qualification: Asks required screening criteria (budget, location, timeline, service needs) before routing.
3. Automated Calendar Scheduling: Checks live availability and books appointments directly into company calendars.
4. Business FAQ Resolution: Accurately answers clinic hours, pricing, office directions, and services using vetted facts.
5. Live Warm Transfers: Immediately bridges VIP callers or medical emergencies to human staff mobile phones.
6. Structured Call Summaries & Transcripts: Automatically sends post-call summaries, action items, and audio recordings via email/SMS.
7. CRM & Database Updates: Creates lead records, updates deal stages, and posts webhook notifications instantly.

Donna AI Pricing Tiers:
- Donna Starter: ₹4,999 / month (Setup from ₹10,000). Best for solo clinics, salons, local service practices. Standard hours, FAQ answering, contact capture, SMS summaries.
- Donna Business: ₹9,999 / month (Setup from ₹20,000). Best for dental clinics, consultancies, high-volume sales. Higher concurrent lines, direct calendar booking, lead qualification, warm transfer, CRM sync.
- Donna Enterprise: ₹19,999 / month (Custom setup). Best for hospital chains, multi-location practices, logistics dispatch. Multi-agent lines, custom voice clone, localized accents, internal ERP API tools, strict SLA.
